"""Source-gated exact yield construction; --check runs without CARLA."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path

from yield_site import ASSIGNMENT
from yield_source import DIMENSIONS, SUFFIXES, load_reviewed


def check(root):
    root = Path(root)
    config = json.loads((root / "config.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    case_id = config.get("selected_case_id")
    if case_id not in {ASSIGNMENT + "__" + suffix for suffix in SUFFIXES}:
        raise ValueError("exact selected yield case required")
    if (config.get("assignment_id"), config.get("law_id"), config.get("cell_id"),
            config.get("actor")) != (ASSIGNMENT, "NRS-484A-450-3", "C24823", "motor_vehicle_driver"):
        raise ValueError("exact assignment scope differs")
    if config.get("rate_hz") != 20 or config.get("duration_s") != 45:
        raise ValueError("original 20 Hz / 45-second capture required")
    if {row["name"]: (row["width"], row["height"]) for row in config.get("cameras", [])} != DIMENSIONS:
        raise ValueError("four-camera capability profile required")
    controller = json.loads((root / "controller.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if controller.get("target_behavior") != case_id.rsplit("__", 1)[1]:
        raise ValueError("exact stop behavior differs")
    throttle = controller.get("throttle")
    if type(throttle) not in (float, int) or not 0 < throttle <= .5:
        raise ValueError("bounded engineering throttle required")
    return {"case_id": case_id, "throttle": float(throttle),
            "source_gate": "reviewed original yield sign, map, crossing inventory, sight geometry, safety context and four-camera placement required"}


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--check", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", default=".")
    parser.add_argument("--yield-review")
    parser.add_argument("--host", default="127.0.0.1")
    parser.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=2000)
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    selected = check(args.output_dir)
    if args.check:
        print(json.dumps({**selected, "native_started": False, "static_construction_valid": True}))
        return 0
    source = args.yield_review or os.environ.get("C24823_YIELD_REVIEW")
    if not source:
        raise ValueError("reviewed original yield source packet required")
    reviewed = load_reviewed(source, selected["case_id"])
    from native_yield_entry import run_native
    print(json.dumps(run_native(reviewed, selected["case_id"], args.output_dir,
                                host=args.host, port=args.port, throttle=selected["throttle"]), sort_keys=True))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""Saved-only original yield-reference analysis; legal judgments stay unresolved."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

from yield_measure import measure, require
from yield_source import CAMERAS


def _sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def _record(name, value, root):
    names = ("original-yield-site.json", "original-yield-trace.jsonl", "original-yield-receipt.json")
    return {"method": name, "sources": {item: _sha(root / item) for item in names}, "value": value}


def measure_reference_hierarchy(root, data):
    return _record("measure_reference_hierarchy", {
        "reference_kind": data["reference"]["reference_kind"],
        "reference_position": data["reference"]["reference_position"],
        "selected_candidate_id": data["reference"]["selected_candidate_id"]}, root)


def measure_original_view(root, data):
    return _record("measure_original_view", {
        "geometric_view_candidate": data["reference"]["selected_candidate_id"],
        "original_approaching_traffic_displacement_m": data["approaching_traffic_displacement_m"],
        "original_driver_view_confirmed": False,
        "source": data["source_bindings"]["original-yield-site.json"]}, root)


def measure_stop_behavior(root, data):
    return _record("measure_stop_behavior", {
        "stop_samples": data["original_stop_samples"],
        "sample_count": data["original_sample_count"],
        "safety_necessity_source": data["safety_necessity_source"],
        "legal_stopping_assessment": None}, root)


def analyze(root, output):
    root, output = Path(root).resolve(), Path(output).resolve()
    config = json.loads(require(root, "config.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    case_id = config["selected_case_id"]
    receipt = json.loads(require(root, "original-yield-receipt.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    data = measure(root, case_id)
    rows = [json.loads(line) for line in require(root, "original-yield-trace.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()]
    mapped = [json.loads(line) for line in require(root, "video_frames.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()]
    graph = [json.loads(line) for line in require(root, "trace.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()]
    if len(rows) != len(mapped) or len(rows) != len(graph):
        raise ValueError("saved original yield graph/frame/vehicle streams differ")
    for index, (row, frame, sample) in enumerate(zip(rows, mapped, graph)):
        if (frame.get("video_frame") != index or frame.get("carla_frame") != row["frame"] or
                frame.get("native_frame") != row["frame"] or sample.get("frame") != row["frame"] or
                abs(frame.get("time_s", -1) - row["time_s"]) > 1e-4):
            raise ValueError("saved original yield frame/time join differs")
    for name in CAMERAS:
        require(root, name + ".mkv")
    if not receipt.get("diagnostic_fixture"):
        from delivery_audit import audit
        audit(root, case_id)
    description = config["case"]["recording_description"]
    channels = root / "channels"
    channels.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    bindings = {
        "original_body_polygon": lambda row: row["ego_vertices"],
        "original_speed": lambda row: row["ego_speed_mps"],
        "yield_control_readback": lambda row: row.get("yield_control_readback", {}),
        "approaching_traffic_readback": lambda row: row["approaching_traffic_readback"],
        "original_view_geometry": lambda row: {"reference": data["reference"],
            "actual_driver_view_confirmed": False},
        "four_camera_frames": lambda row: row["camera_frames"]}
    evidence = []
    for channel in description["channels"]:
        name = channel["name"]
        if name not in bindings:
            raise ValueError("unimplemented original yield channel: " + name)
        relative = "channels/" + name + ".jsonl"
        with (root / relative).open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
            for row in rows:
                stream.write(json.dumps({"time_s": row["time_s"], "value": bindings[name](row)},
                    separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False) + "\n")
        evidence.append({"name": name, "unit": channel["unit"], "reference": relative})
    context = "channels/reviewed_yield_context.json"
    (root / context).write_text(json.dumps({"reviewed_yield_context": {
        "reference": data["reference"],
        "safety_necessity_source": data["safety_necessity_source"],
        "legal_judgment": None}}) + "\n")
    evidence.append({"name": "reviewed_yield_context", "unit": "source", "reference": context})
    native = {"case_id": case_id, "measured_values": {"yield_reference_and_stop": data},
        "target_checks": [{"target": "source-selected yield stopping reference and observed stop trace",
            "requested": config["requested_stop_behavior"],
            "measured": {"reference_kind": data["reference"]["reference_kind"],
                "stop_sample_count": len(data["original_stop_samples"])},
            "method": "yield_measure.measure", "tolerance": 0,
            "matched": False, "physical_cause_confirmed": False,
            "cause_evidence": ["original-yield-site.json", "original-yield-trace.jsonl"]}],
        "setup_confirmed": False, "behavior_attempted": False, "maneuver_completed": False,
        "termination_reason": "Saved original-source measurement; physical and legal review pending",
        "physical_failure_flags": [], "trace_reference": "trace.jsonl",
        "video_references": [name + ".mkv" for name in CAMERAS],
        "video_frame_map_reference": "video_frames.jsonl",
        "recording_description": description, "recording_evidence": evidence,
        "realized_observables": {}, "legal_judgment": None,
        "physical_acceptance_claimed": False}
    from worker_exchange.native_output import physical_result, validate_result
    native = physical_result(root, native)
    if receipt.get("diagnostic_fixture"):
        for check in native["physical_checks"].values():
            check["status"] = "unverified"
            check["missing_evidence"] = ["reviewed original Native yield approach and physical acceptance"]
        native["setup_confirmed"] = native["behavior_attempted"] = native["maneuver_completed"] = False
    validate_result(native)
    (root / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps(native, sort_keys=True, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    report = {"format": "worker-analysis-report", "case_id": case_id,
        "measurements": {"reference_hierarchy": measure_reference_hierarchy(root, data),
            "original_view": measure_original_view(root, data),
            "stop_behavior": measure_stop_behavior(root, data)},
        "limitations": data["limitations"]}
    output.write_text(json.dumps(report, sort_keys=True, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    return report


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--attempt", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    analyze(args.attempt, args.output)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Bind a reviewed original yield site and its proposed Native construction."""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path

from yield_site import ASSIGNMENT, select_stop_reference

CAMERAS = ("overview", "approach", "reference_corner", "driver_reference")
DIMENSIONS = {"overview": (1920, 1080), "approach": (1280, 720),
              "reference_corner": (1280, 720), "driver_reference": (1280, 720)}
SUFFIXES = ("fallback_nearest_view_stop", "fallback_earlier_obscured_stop",
            "marked_line_stop", "nearest_crosswalk_stop", "no_safety_stop_required")


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def load_reviewed(path, case_id):
    path = Path(path).resolve()
    if case_id not in {ASSIGNMENT + "__" + suffix for suffix in SUFFIXES}:
        raise ValueError("unknown exact yield case")
    review = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if review.get("case_id") != case_id or review.get("review_status") != "reviewed_original":
        raise ValueError("exact independently reviewed original yield source required")
    references = review.get("sources")
    if not isinstance(references, dict) or set(references) != {"opendrive", "site_packet", "camera_placement"}:
        raise ValueError("original map, yield site and four-camera placement sources required")
    sources = {}
    for name, ref in references.items():
        source = Path(ref["path"])
        source = (source if source.is_absolute() else path.parent / source).resolve()
        if not source.is_file() or sha(source) != ref.get("sha256"):
            raise ValueError("reviewed original source hash changed: " + name)
        sources[name] = source
    site = json.loads(sources["site_packet"].read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if (site.get("case_id") != case_id or site.get("source_review_status") != "reviewed_original" or
            not site.get("source_records") or site.get("map_sha256") != sha(sources["opendrive"])):
        raise ValueError("original site, map or source-review binding differs")
    required_records = {"yield_sign", "crosswalk_and_line_inventory", "highway_boundary",
                        "occluder_geometry", "driver_viewpoint", "approaching_traffic",
                        "safety_necessity"}
    if not required_records <= set(site["source_records"]):
        raise ValueError("original yield statutory source inventory incomplete")
    for name, ref in site["source_records"].items():
        if not isinstance(ref, dict) or not ref.get("path") or not ref.get("sha256"):
            raise ValueError("source-hashed original yield record required: " + str(name))
        source = Path(ref["path"])
        source = (source if source.is_absolute() else sources["site_packet"].parent / source).resolve()
        if not source.is_file() or sha(source) != ref["sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("original yield source record changed: " + str(name))
    reference = select_stop_reference(sources["site_packet"])
    suffix = case_id.rsplit("__", 1)[1]
    expected = {"fallback_nearest_view_stop": ("nearest_point_with_geometric_view", "yes"),
                "fallback_earlier_obscured_stop": ("nearest_point_with_geometric_view", "yes"),
                "marked_line_stop": ("marked_stop_line", "yes"),
                "nearest_crosswalk_stop": ("nearest_crosswalk", "yes"),
                "no_safety_stop_required": ("nearest_point_with_geometric_view", "no")}
    if (reference["reference_kind"], site["stopping_required_for_safety"]) != expected[suffix]:
        raise ValueError("original stop reference or reviewed safety context differs from exact case")
    if not str(site.get("ego_blueprint", "")).startswith("vehicle.") or not site.get("ego_spawn"):
        raise ValueError("reviewed motor-vehicle spawn required")
    if not isinstance(site.get("occluder_actor_specs"), list) or not site["occluder_actor_specs"]:
        raise ValueError("source-selected original occluder actor construction required")
    if len(site["occluder_actor_specs"]) != len(site["occluders"]):
        raise ValueError("original occluder actor/geometry count differs")
    for spec, rectangle in zip(site["occluder_actor_specs"], site["occluders"]):
        if (not spec.get("blueprint") or not isinstance(spec.get("transform"), dict) or
                spec.get("expected_rectangle_xy_m") != rectangle):
            raise ValueError("original occluder blueprint and transform required")
    sign = site.get("yield_sign_actor_spec")
    if not isinstance(sign, dict) or not sign.get("blueprint") or not isinstance(sign.get("transform"), dict):
        raise ValueError("source-selected original yield-sign actor construction required")
    traffic = site.get("approaching_traffic_actor_specs")
    if (not isinstance(traffic, list) or not traffic or
            len(traffic) != len(site["approaching_traffic_points"])):
        raise ValueError("source-selected approaching traffic actors required")
    for spec, point in zip(traffic, site["approaching_traffic_points"]):
        spawn = spec.get("transform")
        velocity = spec.get("target_velocity_xyz_mps")
        if (not str(spec.get("blueprint", "")).startswith("vehicle.") or
                not isinstance(spawn, dict) or
                not isinstance(velocity, list) or len(velocity) != 3 or
                any(type(v) not in (int, float) or not math.isfinite(v) for v in velocity) or
                math.hypot(velocity[0], velocity[1]) <= .1 or
                any(type(spawn.get(axis)) not in (int, float) or
                    not math.isfinite(spawn[axis]) for axis in ("x", "y")) or
                math.dist((spawn["x"], spawn["y"]), point) > 2):
            raise ValueError("original approaching traffic spawn and motion source differ")
    route = site.get("ego_route")
    if not isinstance(route, list) or len(route) < 3:
        raise ValueError("source-selected original ego route required")
    for point in route:
        if not isinstance(point, dict) or any(type(point.get(key)) not in (float, int) or
                not math.isfinite(point[key]) for key in ("x", "y", "speed_mps")):
            raise ValueError("finite original route point required")
    placement = json.loads(sources["camera_placement"].read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if set(placement.get("cameras", {})) != set(CAMERAS):
        raise ValueError("four original camera placements required")
    for name in CAMERAS:
        row = placement["cameras"][name]
        for key in ("location_xyz_m", "pitch_yaw_roll_deg"):
            vector = row.get(key)
            if not isinstance(vector, list) or len(vector) != 3 or any(
                    type(value) not in (float, int) or not math.isfinite(value) for value in vector):
                raise ValueError("finite original camera pose required: " + name)
    return {"review_sha256": sha(path), "sources": sources, "site": site,
            "reference": reference, "placement": placement}

"""Measure original yield approach samples without making a legal determination.

The nearest-view selector is geometric. A reviewer must still determine whether
the original driver had a view and whether safety required a stop.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path

from yield_site import select_stop_reference


def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def require(root, name):
    path = Path(root) / name
    if not path.is_file():
        raise ValueError("Missing required source: " + name)
    return path


def measure(root, case_id):
    root = Path(root)
    site_path = require(root, "original-yield-site.json")
    trace_path = require(root, "original-yield-trace.jsonl")
    receipt_path = require(root, "original-yield-receipt.json")
    site = json.loads(site_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    receipt = json.loads(receipt_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if site.get("case_id") != case_id or receipt.get("case_id") != case_id:
        raise ValueError("original case identity mismatch")
    if receipt.get("site_sha256") != digest(site_path) or receipt.get("trace_sha256") != digest(trace_path):
        raise ValueError("original source hash mismatch")
    if site.get("source_review_status") not in ("diagnostic_only", "reviewed_original"):
        raise ValueError("source review status missing")
    if site["source_review_status"] == "reviewed_original" and not site.get("source_records"):
        raise ValueError("reviewed original site records missing")
    reference = select_stop_reference(site_path)
    rows = [json.loads(line) for line in trace_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()]
    if len(rows) < 3 or receipt.get("frame_count") != len(rows):
        raise ValueError("original stop trace frame count mismatch")
    previous_frame = previous_time = None
    stops = []
    traffic_first = traffic_last = None
    for index, row in enumerate(rows):
        frame, time = row.get("frame"), row.get("time_s")
        if type(frame) is not int or type(time) not in (int, float) or not math.isfinite(time):
            raise ValueError("invalid original frame or time")
        if previous_frame is not None and (frame != previous_frame + 1 or abs(time - previous_time - .05) > .005):
            raise ValueError("original 20 Hz frame/time join differs")
        previous_frame, previous_time = frame, time
        if row.get("ego_actor_id") != receipt.get("ego_actor_id"):
            raise ValueError("original ego actor differs")
        position, speed = row.get("ego_center_xy_m"), row.get("ego_speed_mps")
        if (not isinstance(position, list) or len(position) != 2 or
                any(type(v) not in (float, int) or not math.isfinite(v) for v in position) or
                type(speed) not in (float, int) or not math.isfinite(speed) or speed < 0):
            raise ValueError("original position/speed missing")
        if row.get("camera_frames") is None:
            raise ValueError("original four-camera frame join missing")
        control = row.get("yield_control_readback")
        if (not isinstance(control, dict) or control.get("yield_sign_id") != site["yield_sign_id"] or
                control.get("control") != "yield_sign"):
            raise ValueError("original yield-sign readback differs")
        if not receipt.get("diagnostic_fixture") and (not control.get("live_actor_id") or
                set(row["camera_frames"]) != {"overview", "approach", "reference_corner", "driver_reference"}):
            raise ValueError("original sign actor or four-camera source missing")
        traffic = row.get("approaching_traffic_readback")
        if (not isinstance(traffic, list) or len(traffic) != len(site["approaching_traffic_points"]) or
                any(not item.get("actor_id") or not isinstance(item.get("position_xy_m"), list) or
                    len(item["position_xy_m"]) != 2 or any(
                        type(v) not in (float, int) or not math.isfinite(v)
                        for v in item["position_xy_m"]) for item in traffic)):
            raise ValueError("original approaching traffic actor readback missing")
        if traffic_first is None:
            traffic_first = traffic
        traffic_last = traffic
        vertices = row.get("ego_vertices")
        if (not isinstance(vertices, list) or len(vertices) != 8 or any(
                not isinstance(vertex, list) or len(vertex) != 3 or any(
                    type(value) not in (float, int) or not math.isfinite(value) for value in vertex)
                for vertex in vertices)):
            raise ValueError("original eight-vertex motor-vehicle body missing")
        # A small speed is an engineering witness only; preserve the full trace.
        if speed <= .1 and position[0] < site["intersecting_highway_boundary_x"]:
            stops.append({"frame": frame, "time_s": time, "position_xy_m": position,
                          "distance_to_reference_m": math.dist(position, reference["reference_position"]),
                          "leading_body_x_minus_reference_x_m": max(vertex[0] for vertex in vertices) -
                              reference["reference_position"][0]})
    traffic_progress = [math.dist(a["position_xy_m"], b["position_xy_m"])
                        for a, b in zip(traffic_first, traffic_last)]
    if not receipt.get("diagnostic_fixture") and any(distance < 1 for distance in traffic_progress):
        raise ValueError("original approaching traffic motion not demonstrated")
    return {"case_id": case_id, "reference": reference,
            "original_stop_samples": stops, "original_sample_count": len(rows),
            "approaching_traffic_displacement_m": traffic_progress,
            "source_bindings": {name: digest(root / name) for name in
                ("original-yield-site.json", "original-yield-trace.jsonl", "original-yield-receipt.json")},
            "safety_necessity_source": site.get("safety_necessity_source"),
            "legal_judgment": None,
            "limitations": ["0.1 m/s is a diagnostic stop-sample threshold, not a legal cutoff.",
                            "Geometric view rays do not establish what the original driver saw.",
                            "Safety necessity and adequacy of stopping remain independent reviews."]}

"""Acquire a reviewed yield approach; never infer legal or physical acceptance."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import math
import os
from pathlib import Path

from carla_yield_readback import CameraFrames, body_vertices
from capture_yield import capture
from yield_source import CAMERAS, DIMENSIONS, sha
from yield_video_sources import encode_original_cameras


def _transform(carla, row):
    return carla.Transform(carla.Location(x=float(row["x"]), y=float(row["y"]),
                                         z=float(row.get("z", 0))),
                           carla.Rotation(yaw=float(row.get("yaw", 0))))


def _release(actors):
    for actor in actors.values():
        try:
            if hasattr(actor, "stop"):
                actor.stop()
        finally:
            actor.destroy()


class YieldControl:
    """Bounded waypoint control with a source-selected stopping target."""

    def __init__(self, site, case_id, vehicle_control, *, throttle=.3):
        if not 0 < throttle <= .5:
            raise ValueError("bounded engineering throttle required")
        self.route = site["ego_route"]
        self.factory = vehicle_control
        self.throttle = float(throttle)
        self.index = 1
        self.hold = 0
        self.no_stop = case_id.endswith("no_safety_stop_required")
        if case_id.endswith("fallback_earlier_obscured_stop"):
            self.target = site.get("earlier_obscured_stop_position")
            if not isinstance(self.target, list) or len(self.target) != 2:
                raise ValueError("source-positioned earlier obscured stop required")
        else:
            from yield_site import select_stop_reference
            # The caller stores a byte-identical reviewed site source path.
            self.target = None

    def set_reference(self, reference):
        if self.target is None:
            self.target = reference["reference_position"]

    def __call__(self, actor, tick):
        if type(tick) is not int or tick < 0 or self.target is None:
            raise ValueError("original control target missing")
        pose = actor.get_transform()
        x, y = float(pose.location.x), float(pose.location.y)
        if not all(math.isfinite(v) for v in (x, y)):
            raise ValueError("original ego pose nonfinite")
        if not self.no_stop and math.dist((x, y), self.target) <= 1.5:
            self.hold += 1
            actor.apply_control(self.factory(throttle=0, steer=0, brake=1))
            return
        if self.index >= len(self.route):
            actor.apply_control(self.factory(throttle=0, steer=0, brake=1))
            return
        target = self.route[self.index]
        if math.dist((x, y), (target["x"], target["y"])) < .8:
            self.index += 1
            if self.index >= len(self.route):
                actor.apply_control(self.factory(throttle=0, steer=0, brake=1))
                return
            target = self.route[self.index]
        yaw = math.radians(float(pose.rotation.yaw))
        direction = math.atan2(target["y"] - y, target["x"] - x)
        error = (direction - yaw + math.pi) % (2 * math.pi) - math.pi
        distance = max(.8, math.dist((x, y), (target["x"], target["y"])))
        steer = max(-1., min(1., math.atan(2.7 * 2 * math.sin(error) / distance) / .65))
        actor.apply_control(self.factory(throttle=self.throttle, steer=steer, brake=0))


def _cameras(world, carla, placement, bridge):
    sensors = {}
    try:
        for name in CAMERAS:
            row = placement["cameras"][name]
            xyz, pyr = row["location_xyz_m"], row["pitch_yaw_roll_deg"]
            width, height = DIMENSIONS[name]
            bp = world.get_blueprint_library().find("sensor.camera.rgb")
            for key, value in (("image_size_x", width), ("image_size_y", height), ("sensor_tick", .05)):
                bp.set_attribute(key, str(value))
            pose = carla.Transform(carla.Location(x=xyz[0], y=xyz[1], z=xyz[2]),
                carla.Rotation(pitch=pyr[0], yaw=pyr[1], roll=pyr[2]))
            sensor = world.try_spawn_actor(bp, pose)
            if sensor is None or sensor.type_id != "sensor.camera.rgb":
                raise RuntimeError("original yield camera spawn failed: " + name)
            sensors[name] = sensor
            sensor.listen(bridge.callback(name))
        return sensors
    except BaseException:
        _release(sensors)
        raise


def run_native(reviewed, case_id, output_dir, *, host="127.0.0.1", port=2000, throttle=.3):
    output = Path(output_dir).resolve()
    if not output.is_dir() or any((output / name).exists() for name in
            ("original-yield-site.json", "original-yield-trace.jsonl", "original-yield-receipt.json", "native-seal.json")):
        raise ValueError("fresh materialized original Native attempt required")
    if "SCENARIO_PIPELINE_OUTPUT_ROOT" not in os.environ:
        raise ValueError("SCENARIO_PIPELINE_OUTPUT_ROOT required before runtime import")
    import carla
    from pipeline_capture import PipelineCapture
    from worker_exchange.native_output import FrameMap, seal_capture
    from worker_exchange.world_restore import snapshot as snapshot_world, restore

    client = carla.Client(host, int(port))
    client.set_timeout(30)
    before = snapshot_world(client)
    sensors, actors = {}, {}
    graph = frame_map = None
    failure = receipt = None
    restored = False
    try:
        site = reviewed["site"]
        world = client.generate_opendrive_world(reviewed["sources"]["opendrive"].read_text())
        if world.get_map().name != site["map_name"] or sha(reviewed["sources"]["opendrive"]) != site["map_sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("live original map differs from reviewed yield source")
        settings = world.get_settings()
        settings.synchronous_mode = True
        settings.fixed_delta_seconds = .05
        settings.no_rendering_mode = False
        world.apply_settings(settings)
        bp = world.get_blueprint_library().find(site["ego_blueprint"])
        ego = world.try_spawn_actor(bp, _transform(carla, site["ego_spawn"]))
        if ego is None or not ego.type_id.startswith("vehicle."):
            raise RuntimeError("source-selected motor vehicle failed to spawn")
        actors["ego"] = ego
        sign_spec = site["yield_sign_actor_spec"]
        bp = world.get_blueprint_library().find(sign_spec["blueprint"])
        sign = world.try_spawn_actor(bp, _transform(carla, sign_spec["transform"]))
        if sign is None or not sign.is_alive:
            raise RuntimeError("original yield-sign actor failed to spawn")
        actors["yield_sign"] = sign
        for index, spec in enumerate(site.get("occluder_actor_specs", [])):
            bp = world.get_blueprint_library().find(spec["blueprint"])
            occluder = world.try_spawn_actor(bp, _transform(carla, spec["transform"]))
            if occluder is None or not occluder.is_alive:
                raise RuntimeError("original blind-approach occluder failed to spawn")
            vertices = occluder.bounding_box.get_world_vertices(occluder.get_transform())
            actual = [min(vertex.x for vertex in vertices), min(vertex.y for vertex in vertices),
                      max(vertex.x for vertex in vertices), max(vertex.y for vertex in vertices)]
            if any(abs(a - b) > 1 for a, b in zip(actual, spec["expected_rectangle_xy_m"])):
                raise RuntimeError("original occluder physical readback differs from reviewed geometry")
            actors["occluder_" + str(index)] = occluder
        traffic = []
        for index, spec in enumerate(site["approaching_traffic_actor_specs"]):
            bp = world.get_blueprint_library().find(spec["blueprint"])
            vehicle = world.try_spawn_actor(bp, _transform(carla, spec["transform"]))
            if vehicle is None or not vehicle.is_alive or not vehicle.type_id.startswith("vehicle."):
                raise RuntimeError("source-selected approaching traffic actor failed to spawn")
            actors["traffic_" + str(index)] = vehicle
            traffic.append((vehicle, spec))
        bridge = CameraFrames()
        sensors = _cameras(world, carla, reviewed["placement"], bridge)
        graph = PipelineCapture(client, ego, output, case_id)
        frame_map = FrameMap(output / "video_frames.jsonl")
        source = output / "original-yield-site.json"
        source.write_bytes(reviewed["sources"]["site_packet"].read_bytes())
        control = YieldControl(site, case_id, carla.VehicleControl, throttle=throttle)
        control.set_reference(reviewed["reference"])

        def after_tick(frame, time_s, row):
            sampled = graph.capture(frame, time_s, {"original_yield_source_sha256": sha(source)})
            if sampled["frame"] != frame or abs(sampled["time_s"] - time_s) > 1e-6:
                raise ValueError("original graph and yield vehicle frame join differs")
            frame_map.append(frame, time_s)

        receipt = capture(world, ego, source, sha(source), case_id, output, control,
            body_vertices, lambda actor: actor.apply_control(carla.VehicleControl(brake=1)),
            camera_readers=bridge.readers(), after_tick=after_tick,
            control_readback=lambda frame: {"yield_sign_id": site["yield_sign_id"],
                "control": "yield_sign", "live_actor_id": sign.id,
                "live_actor_type": sign.type_id, "source_frame_id": frame},
            before_tick=lambda index: [vehicle.set_target_velocity(carla.Vector3D(*spec["target_velocity_xyz_mps"]))
                                       for vehicle, spec in traffic],
            traffic_readback=lambda frame: [{"actor_id": vehicle.id, "source_frame_id": frame,
                "position_xy_m": [float(vehicle.get_location().x), float(vehicle.get_location().y)],
                "velocity_xy_mps": [float(vehicle.get_velocity().x), float(vehicle.get_velocity().y)]}
                for vehicle, _ in traffic])
    except BaseException as error:
        failure = error
    finally:
        for resource in (frame_map, graph):
            if resource is not None:
                try:
                    if resource is graph:
                        resource.close(confirmed=failure is None)
                    else:
                        resource.close()
                except BaseException as error:
                    failure = failure or error
        for group in (sensors, actors):
            try:
                _release(group)
            except BaseException as error:
                failure = failure or error
        try:
            restored = bool(restore(client, before).get("restored"))
        except BaseException as error:
            failure = failure or error
    if failure is not None or not restored or receipt is None:
        (output / "native-run-status.json").write_text(json.dumps({
            "phase": "failed", "error": repr(failure), "restored": restored}, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
        raise RuntimeError("original yield acquisition or restoration failed") from failure
    videos = encode_original_cameras(receipt["receipt"], receipt["trace"])
    seal_capture(output, frames=900, restoration={"restored": True}, errors=[],
        encoder_exit_codes={name: 0 for name in CAMERAS},
        context={"case_id": case_id, "review_sha256": reviewed["review_sha256"],
                 "legal_verdict_claimed": False})
    seal = {"case_id": case_id, "review_sha256": reviewed["review_sha256"],
            "site_sha256": sha(output / "original-yield-site.json"),
            "trace_sha256": receipt["trace_sha256"], "source_receipt_sha256": receipt["receipt_sha256"],
            "video_sources_sha256": {name: row["sha256"] for name, row in videos.items()},
            "restored": True, "frame_count": 900, "physical_acceptance": False}
    (output / "native-seal.json").write_text(json.dumps(seal, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
    return seal

"""Capture 900 original 20 Hz yield-approach samples and four PNG frame streams."""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import math
from io import BytesIO
from pathlib import Path
from zipfile import ZIP_STORED, ZipFile

from PIL import Image

from yield_site import ASSIGNMENT as ASSIGNMENT_ID, select_stop_reference
from yield_source import CAMERAS, DIMENSIONS, sha


def _camera_image(reader, frame, dimensions):
    sample = reader(frame)
    if not isinstance(sample, dict) or sample.get("frame") != frame:
        raise ValueError("original camera frame identity mismatch")
    payload = sample.get("png_bytes")
    if not isinstance(payload, bytes) or not payload.startswith(b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"):
        raise ValueError("original camera PNG missing")
    with Image.open(BytesIO(payload)) as image:
        image.verify()
    with Image.open(BytesIO(payload)) as image:
        if image.format != "PNG" or image.size != tuple(dimensions):
            raise ValueError("original camera dimensions mismatch")
    return payload


def capture(world, ego, packet_path, packet_sha, case_id, output_dir, control,
            body_reader, brake, *, ticks=900, camera_readers, after_tick=None,
            control_readback=None, before_tick=None, traffic_readback=None):
    packet_path = Path(packet_path)
    if sha(packet_path) != packet_sha:
        raise ValueError("original yield site packet changed")
    packet = json.loads(packet_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    select_stop_reference(packet_path)
    if packet.get("case_id") != case_id:
        raise ValueError("original yield case mismatch")
    if (type(ticks) is not int or ticks != 900 or not all(callable(fn) for fn in
            (control, body_reader, brake, control_readback, before_tick, traffic_readback)) or
            set(camera_readers) != set(CAMERAS)):
        raise ValueError("complete 900-tick original acquisition callbacks required")
    settings = world.get_settings()
    if not settings.synchronous_mode or abs(settings.fixed_delta_seconds - .05) > 1e-9:
        raise ValueError("original world must be synchronous at 20 Hz")
    if world.get_map().name != packet["map_name"] or not ego.type_id.startswith("vehicle."):
        raise ValueError("live original map or motor vehicle mismatch")
    output = Path(output_dir)
    trace = output / "original-yield-trace.jsonl"
    receipt = output / "original-yield-receipt.json"
    media = {name: output / ("original-" + name + ".png.zip") for name in CAMERAS}
    if any(path.exists() for path in (trace, receipt, *media.values())):
        raise ValueError("fresh original capture output required")
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    archives = {name: ZipFile(path, "w", compression=ZIP_STORED) for name, path in media.items()}
    rows = []
    previous = None
    try:
        for index in range(ticks):
            control(ego, index)
            before_tick(index)
            tick_frame = world.tick()
            snap = world.get_snapshot()
            frame, time_s = snap.frame, float(snap.timestamp.elapsed_seconds)
            if (type(frame) is not int or frame != tick_frame or not math.isfinite(time_s) or
                    previous is not None and (frame != previous[0] + 1 or abs(time_s - previous[1] - .05) > .002)):
                raise ValueError("original 20 Hz frame order changed")
            transform = ego.get_transform()
            center = [float(transform.location.x), float(transform.location.y)]
            yaw = math.radians(float(transform.rotation.yaw))
            heading = [math.cos(yaw), math.sin(yaw)]
            waypoint = world.get_map().get_waypoint(transform.location, project_to_road=False)
            if waypoint is None:
                raise ValueError("original live circulation lane missing")
            lane_id = str(waypoint.road_id) + ":" + str(waypoint.lane_id)
            vertices = body_reader(ego)
            if not isinstance(vertices, list) or len(vertices) != 8 or any(
                    not isinstance(point, list) or len(point) != 3 or any(
                        type(value) not in (int, float) or not math.isfinite(value)
                        for value in point) for point in vertices):
                raise ValueError("eight finite original world-space body vertices required")
            velocity = ego.get_velocity()
            speed = math.sqrt(sum(float(getattr(velocity, axis)) ** 2 for axis in ("x", "y", "z")))
            source_control = control_readback(frame)
            if (not isinstance(source_control, dict) or
                    source_control.get("yield_sign_id") != packet["yield_sign_id"] or
                    source_control.get("control") != "yield_sign" or
                    not source_control.get("live_actor_id")):
                raise ValueError("original live yield-sign control readback differs")
            traffic = traffic_readback(frame)
            if (not isinstance(traffic, list) or len(traffic) != len(packet["approaching_traffic_points"]) or
                    any(not item.get("actor_id") or item.get("source_frame_id") != frame or
                        not item.get("position_xy_m") or not item.get("velocity_xy_mps")
                        for item in traffic)):
                raise ValueError("original approaching traffic actor readback differs")
            row = {"frame": frame, "time_s": time_s, "ego_actor_id": ego.id,
                   "ego_center_xy_m": center, "ego_lane_id": lane_id,
                   "ego_vertices": vertices, "ego_speed_mps": speed,
                   "yield_control_readback": source_control,
                   "approaching_traffic_readback": traffic, "camera_frames": {}}
            for name in CAMERAS:
                payload = _camera_image(camera_readers[name], frame, DIMENSIONS[name])
                member = f"{frame:08d}.png"
                archives[name].writestr(member, payload)
                row["camera_frames"][name] = {"member": member,
                    "sha256": hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()}
            if after_tick is not None:
                after_tick(frame, time_s, row)
            rows.append(row)
            previous = (frame, time_s)
    except BaseException:
        try:
            brake(ego)
        except Exception:
            pass
        raise
    finally:
        for archive in archives.values():
            archive.close()
        if len(rows) != ticks:
            for path in media.values():
                path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    payload = "".join(json.dumps(row, sort_keys=True) + "\n" for row in rows).encode()
    trace.write_bytes(payload)
    receipt.write_text(json.dumps({"assignment_id": ASSIGNMENT_ID, "case_id": case_id,
        "diagnostic_fixture": False, "fps": 20, "frame_count": ticks,
        "site_sha256": packet_sha, "trace_sha256": hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest(),
        "ego_actor_id": ego.id, "camera_capture_complete": True,
        "camera_sources": {name: {"path": path.name, "sha256": sha(path),
            "frame_count": ticks, "dimensions": list(DIMENSIONS[name])}
            for name, path in media.items()}}, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    return {"trace": str(trace), "receipt": str(receipt),
            "trace_sha256": sha(trace), "receipt_sha256": sha(receipt)}

"""Encode sealed original PNG camera frames as lossless 20 Hz video sources."""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import tempfile
from zipfile import ZipFile

from yield_source import CAMERAS


def _sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def encode_original_cameras(receipt_path, trace_path, *, ffmpeg="ffmpeg"):
    receipt_path = Path(receipt_path).resolve()
    root = receipt_path.parent
    receipt = json.loads(receipt_path.read_text())
    rows = [json.loads(line) for line in Path(trace_path).read_text().splitlines()]
    sources = receipt.get("camera_sources", {})
    if len(rows) != 900 or set(sources) != set(CAMERAS):
        raise ValueError("full original four-camera source required")
    scratch_root = Path(os.environ["TMPDIR"]).resolve()
    if ".runtime-work" not in scratch_root.parts:
        raise ValueError("camera encoding scratch must be under .runtime-work")
    encoded = {}
    for name in CAMERAS:
        source = (root / sources[name]["path"]).resolve()
        target = root / (name + ".mkv")
        if source.parent != root or target.exists() or _sha(source) != sources[name]["sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("original camera source changed or output exists: " + name)
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=scratch_root, prefix="c24823-camera-") as temp:
            scratch = Path(temp)
            with ZipFile(source) as archive:
                members = [f"{row['frame']:08d}.png" for row in rows]
                if archive.namelist() != members:
                    raise ValueError("original camera frame order differs: " + name)
                for index, (row, member) in enumerate(zip(rows, members)):
                    payload = archive.read(member)
                    if row.get("camera_frames", {}).get(name) != {
                            "member": member, "sha256": hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()}:
                        raise ValueError("original camera frame hash differs: " + name)
                    (scratch / f"{index:08d}.png").write_bytes(payload)
            command = [ffmpeg, "-hide_banner", "-loglevel", "error", "-nostdin",
                "-y", "-framerate", "20", "-start_number", "0", "-i",
                str(scratch / "%08d.png"), "-an", "-c:v", "ffv1", "-level", "3",
                str(target)]
            subprocess.run(command, check=True, timeout=1800,
                           stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
        encoded[name] = {"path": str(target), "sha256": _sha(target),
                         "frame_count": 900, "fps": 20}
    return encoded

"""Independent exact-case original yield source, time and four-video audit."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
from zipfile import ZipFile

from yield_site import ASSIGNMENT as ASSIGNMENT_ID
from yield_source import SUFFIXES
from yield_measure import measure
from yield_source import CAMERAS, DIMENSIONS


def required(root, name):
    path = root / name
    if not path.is_file():
        raise ValueError("Missing required source: " + name)
    return path


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def rows(path):
    return [json.loads(line) for line in Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()]


def decode(path, dimensions, count):
    probe = subprocess.run(["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-count_frames", "-select_streams", "v:0",
        "-show_entries", "stream=codec_name,width,height,nb_read_frames,avg_frame_rate",
        "-of", "json", str(path)], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True, timeout=180)
    streams = json.loads(probe.stdout).get("streams", [])
    if len(streams) != 1 or (streams[0].get("width"), streams[0].get("height")) != tuple(dimensions) or (
            int(streams[0].get("nb_read_frames", -1)) != count or
            streams[0].get("avg_frame_rate") != "20/1"):
        raise ValueError("original camera profile or count differs: " + path.name)
    process = subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-nostdin", "-v", "error", "-xerror", "-i", str(path),
        "-map", "0:v:0", "-f", "null", "-"], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=600)
    if process.returncode:
        raise ValueError("original camera full decode failed: " + path.name + " " + process.stderr[-200:])
    return {"sha256": sha(path), "decoded_frames": count,
            "dimensions": list(dimensions), "fps": 20}


def audit(attempt, case_id, *, diagnostic=False):
    attempt = Path(attempt).resolve()
    if case_id not in {ASSIGNMENT_ID + "__" + suffix for suffix in SUFFIXES}:
        raise ValueError("unknown exact yield delivery case")
    map_path = required(attempt, "original-yield-site.json")
    trace_path = required(attempt, "original-yield-trace.jsonl")
    receipt_path = required(attempt, "original-yield-receipt.json")
    receipt = json.loads(receipt_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if receipt.get("case_id") != case_id or bool(receipt.get("diagnostic_fixture")) != diagnostic:
        raise ValueError("original source provenance or exact case differs")
    if diagnostic:
        provenance = json.loads(required(attempt, "fixture-provenance.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        if provenance.get("case_id") != case_id or "CPU diagnostic only" not in provenance.get("scope", ""):
            raise ValueError("explicit exact diagnostic provenance required")
    elif receipt.get("frame_count") != 900 or not receipt.get("camera_capture_complete"):
        raise ValueError("full original four-camera Native yield capture required")
    if not diagnostic:
        site = json.loads(map_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        if site.get("source_review_status") != "reviewed_original":
            raise ValueError("reviewed original yield site required")
        seal = json.loads(required(attempt, "native-seal.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        if (seal.get("case_id") != case_id or seal.get("frame_count") != 900 or
                seal.get("site_sha256") != sha(map_path) or
                seal.get("trace_sha256") != sha(trace_path) or
                seal.get("restored") is not True):
            raise ValueError("original Native completion or source seal differs")
    motion = measure(attempt, case_id)
    original = rows(trace_path)
    mapping = rows(required(attempt, "video_frames.jsonl"))
    graph = rows(required(attempt, "trace.jsonl"))
    if not original or len(original) != len(mapping) or len(original) != len(graph):
        raise ValueError("original source/frame/graph counts differ")
    for index, (body, mapped, sampled) in enumerate(zip(original, mapping, graph)):
        if (mapped.get("video_frame") != index or mapped.get("carla_frame") != body["frame"] or
                mapped.get("native_frame") != body["frame"] or sampled.get("frame") != body["frame"] or
                abs(mapped.get("time_s", -1) - body["time_s"]) > 1e-4):
            raise ValueError("original source/frame/time join differs")
    videos = {name: decode(required(attempt, name + ".mkv"), DIMENSIONS[name], len(original))
              for name in CAMERAS}
    png_sources = {}
    if not diagnostic:
        if set(receipt.get("camera_sources", {})) != set(CAMERAS):
            raise ValueError("all original camera source archives required")
        for name in CAMERAS:
            spec = receipt["camera_sources"][name]
            source = required(attempt, spec["path"])
            if sha(source) != spec.get("sha256") or spec.get("frame_count") != 900:
                raise ValueError("original camera source archive changed: " + name)
            with ZipFile(source) as archive:
                expected = [f"{row['frame']:08d}.png" for row in original]
                if archive.namelist() != expected:
                    raise ValueError("original camera source frame order differs: " + name)
                for row, member in zip(original, expected):
                    pixels = archive.read(member)
                    if row.get("camera_frames", {}).get(name) != {
                            "member": member, "sha256": hashlib.sha256(pixels).hexdigest()}:
                        raise ValueError("original camera pixel source changed: " + name)
            png_sources[name] = sha(source)
    return {"format": "worker-independent-yield-delivery-audit",
        "case_id": case_id, "diagnostic_fixture": diagnostic,
        "site_sha256": sha(map_path), "trace_sha256": sha(trace_path),
        "receipt_sha256": sha(receipt_path), "frame_count": len(original),
        "decoded_images": len(original) * 4, "full_encoded_camera_decodes": 4,
        "videos": videos, "original_png_archives_sha256": png_sources,
        "reference_kind": motion["reference"]["reference_kind"],
        "stop_sample_count": len(motion["original_stop_samples"]),
        "original_driver_view": "unverified", "actual_pixels_verified": False,
        "physical_acceptance": False, "legal_verdict": None}


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--attempt", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--case-id", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--diagnostic", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    output = Path(args.output)
    if output.exists():
        raise ValueError("refusing to overwrite independent audit receipt")
    result = audit(args.attempt, args.case_id, diagnostic=args.diagnostic)
    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    output.write_text(json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps({"case_id": args.case_id, "frame_count": result["frame_count"],
                      "diagnostic_fixture": args.diagnostic, "physical_acceptance": False}))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
